description: Use this when deliveries exist for an agreement and you want GAIP's signed finding. Pass the `agreement_id` and your `continuity_handle`. Returns MET, NOT_MET or INDETERMINATE on the agreed rule with the records relied on. Evidence only; no sum of money. Free, no account; records a GAIP receipt only. Inputs must be public and non-personal.

continuity_handle.description: Required: a party's own continuity handle.

name: witness_finding
title: Was the agreed rule met? (signed finding)
